blocks.text: have va have got — bir ma'no, ikki shakl

Egalik va aloqa ma'nosida **have** va **have got** bir xil: I **have** a car = I**'ve got** a car — «Mening mashinam bor». Asoslari qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 9- va 58-darslar). **have got** — Britaniya og'zaki nutqiga xos, **have** — neytral, rasmiyroq va Amerika ingliz tilida asosiy shakl. O'zbek tilida «bor» — fe'l emas, shuning uchun o'zbeklar ko'pincha shakllarni aralashtirib yuborishadi. Bu darsda uchta nozik joyni ko'ramiz: savol va inkor, zamonlar, hamda **got** umuman ishlatilmaydigan harakat ma'nosi.

rows: I**'ve got** / she**'s got** a car.
I **haven't got** / she **hasn't got** a car.
I **don't have** / she **doesn't have** a car.

items.text: **Do** you **have** a pen? — No, I **don't**, sorry.
She **hasn't got** any brothers, and she **doesn't have** any sisters either.

blocks.text: Nimalar uchun: egalik, oila, kasallik, uchrashuv, muammo

have (got) faqat narsalar uchun emas. U **oila va do'stlar** (two sisters, a lot of friends), **tashqi ko'rinish** (blue eyes, long hair), **kasallik** (a cold, a headache, a temperature, a sore throat), **reja va uchrashuvlar** (a meeting at three, an exam tomorrow), **muammo, fikr, vaqt** (a problem, an idea, no time) haqida ham ishlatiladi. O'zbekcha «Boshim og'riyapti» → I**'ve got a headache**, «Isitmam bor» → I**'ve got a temperature**, «Vaqtim yo'q» → I **haven't got** time. Kasallik nomlari oldida odatda **a** turadi: a cold, a headache (lekin: the flu).

items.text: I**'ve got** a sore throat, so I'm not going to sing today.
items.translation: **Tomog'im og'riyapti**, shuning uchun bugun qo'shiq aytmayman.

items.text: We**'ve got** an appointment with the dentist at four.
items.translation: Soat to'rtda tish shifokori bilan **uchrashuvimiz bor**.

items.text: Bekzod **has** a lot of experience in marketing.

blocks.text: **have got** Present Perfect ga o'xshasa ham, aslida hozirgi zamon shakli. Boshqa zamonlarda va boshqa shakllarda faqat **have** ishlatiladi: o'tmishda — **had**, **didn't have**, **Did** you **have** ...? (egalik ma'nosida «had got» deyarli ishlatilmaydi); kelasida — **will have**; modal fe'l va **to** dan keyin — can have, need to have, would like to have; -ing shakli — having. «Have you a car?» (do va got siz) — eskirgan, rasmiy uslub.

rows: I **had** a bike. **Did** you **have** a bike?
I had got a bike. Had you got a bike?
We will have got a new office.
I'd like to have got a dog.

blocks.text: **have** + ot ko'pincha egalik emas, **harakat**ni bildiradi: have breakfast (nonushta qilmoq), have a shower (dush qabul qilmoq), have a rest (dam olmoq), have a good time (maza qilmoq). Bunday iboralarda **got** ishlatilmaydi, have esa oddiy fe'l kabi ishlaydi: Continuous da kela oladi (I**'m having** lunch), savol va inkorda — do / does / did (What time **do** you **have** lunch? **Did** you **have** a good time?). Egalik ma'nosidagi have esa Continuous da kelmaydi: «I'm having a car» — xato.

rows: **have** a rest / a break / a holiday
dam olmoq / tanaffus qilmoq / ta'tilga chiqmoq
**have** a coffee / a cup of tea

items.text: Sorry, I can't talk — **I'm having** a meeting.
What time **do** you **have** dinner? — Usually at eight.
items.translation: Soat nechada **kechki ovqat qilasiz**? — Odatda sakkizda.

items.text: We **had** a wonderful time in Khiva.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have got breakfast at seven» → I **have** breakfast (harakat — got yo'q); «I'm having a car» → I**'ve got** / I **have** a car; «Do you have got ...?» → **Have** you **got** ...? yoki **Do** you **have** ...?; «Have you got a car? — Yes, I do» → Yes, I **have**; «I don't have got» → I **haven't got** / I **don't have**; «I had got a dog as a child» → I **had** a dog; «I have headache» → I've got **a** headache; «I have 25 years» → I**'m** 25.

Amerika ingliz tilida **Do you have ...?** va **I don't have** ancha ko'p ishlatiladi, **gotten** shakli ham bor (Britaniyada — got). **have got to** + fe'l esa butunlay boshqa ma'no — «majbur bo'lmoq»: I've got to go = I have to go (→ 31-dars).

Tekshirish: gapni «**is having** / **was having**» ga aylantirib ko'ring. Ma'no buzilmasa (u tushlik qilyapti, ular janjallashyapti) — bu harakat, faqat **have**. Buzilsa (mashina «qilyapti»?) — bu egalik yoki holat: **have** yoki **have got**.

rows: We **had** a dog. We**'ll have** a garden.

examples.title: Possession and people: **have got** / **have**
examples.description: Egalik, oila, tashqi ko'rinish: have got (og'zaki British) va have (neytral) bir xil ma'no beradi. O'zbekchada «...im bor».

sentences.text: My brother **has got** a flat in the centre of Tashkent, near the metro.
sentences.translation: Akamning Toshkent markazida, metro yaqinida **kvartirasi bor**.

sentences.text: We**'ve got** two cats and a very lazy dog.
sentences.translation: Bizning ikkita mushugimiz va juda dangasa **itimiz bor**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has** three older brothers, and they all live in Leeds.
sentences.translation: Saraning uchta **akasi bor**, ularning hammasi Lidsda yashaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur**'s got** dark hair and a beard, so you'll recognise him easily.
sentences.translation: Jasurning qora **sochi va soqoli bor**, uni oson tanib olasiz.

sentences.text: Our new office **has** a gym on the top floor.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisimizda yuqori qavatda sport **zali bor**.

sentences.text: I**'ve got** an old bike that I use to get to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga borish uchun minadigan eski **velosipedim bor**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **has** a lot of friends abroad because she studied in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning chet elda ko'p **do'stlari bor**, chunki u Edinburgda o'qigan.

sentences.text: These flats **have got** huge windows, but they're very cold in winter.
sentences.translation: Bu kvartiralarning ulkan **derazalari bor**, lekin qishda juda sovuq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Kate and Tom **have got** a cottage in the countryside where they spend every summer.
sentences.translation: Keyt va Tomning qishloqda kichik **uyi bor**, har yozni o'sha yerda o'tkazishadi.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan **has** a rich history and some of the oldest cities in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonning boy **tarixi** va Markaziy Osiyodagi eng qadimiy shaharlaridan ba'zilari **bor**.

examples.title: Illness, plans, problems: **I've got** a headache
examples.description: have (got) faqat narsalar uchun emas: kasallik (a cold, a temperature), uchrashuv va rejalar (a meeting, an exam), muammo, fikr, vaqt.

sentences.text: **I've got** a terrible headache, so I'm going to lie down.
sentences.translation: **Boshim qattiq og'riyapti**, borib biroz yotaman.

sentences.text: Madina can't come — she**'s got** a temperature and a sore throat.
sentences.translation: Madina kela olmaydi — **isitmasi bor**, tomog'i ham og'riyapti.

sentences.text: We**'ve got** a meeting with the bank at three o'clock.
sentences.translation: Soat uchda bank bilan **uchrashuvimiz bor**.

sentences.text: **Has** Aziz **got** an exam tomorrow? He looks really nervous.
sentences.translation: Azizning ertaga **imtihoni bormi**? Juda hayajonlangan ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **haven't got** time to chat right now — my train leaves in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplashishga **vaqtim yo'q** — poyezdim o'n daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

sentences.text: The company **has** serious financial problems, according to the newspapers.
sentences.translation: Gazetalarning yozishicha, kompaniyaning jiddiy moliyaviy **muammolari bor**.

sentences.text: Listen, I**'ve got** an idea: why don't we cook plov for the whole team?
sentences.translation: Quloq sol, **bir fikrim bor**: nega butun jamoaga palov damlamaymiz?

sentences.text: **Do** you **have** any plans for the weekend, or are you free?
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlariga **rejalaringiz bormi** yoki bo'shmisiz?

sentences.text: Poor Oliver **has got** the flu again, so he's working from home.
sentences.translation: Bechora Oliver yana **grippga chalinibdi**, shuning uchun uydan ishlayapti.

sentences.text: My grandmother **has** high blood pressure, so she has to avoid salty food.
sentences.translation: Buvimning **qon bosimi baland**, shuning uchun sho'r ovqatdan saqlanishi kerak.

examples.title: **Have** you **got** ...? / **Do** you **have** ...?
examples.description: Ikki to'g'ri qolip: Have you got ...? — Yes, I have. / Do you have ...? — Yes, I do. Inkor: haven't got / don't have. Ularni aralashtirib bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: **Have** you **got** a charger for this phone? — Yes, I **have**. Here you are.
sentences.translation: Bu telefonga **quvvatlagichingiz bormi**? — Ha, **bor**. Mana, oling.

sentences.text: **Do** you **have** a student discount? — No, we **don't**, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Talabalar uchun **chegirmangiz bormi**? — Afsuski, **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **hasn't got** a car, so he cycles everywhere.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning **mashinasi yo'q**, shuning uchun hamma joyga velosipedda boradi.

sentences.text: We **don't have** much money this month because of the repairs.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir tufayli bu oy **pulimiz ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: **Has** your hotel **got** free Wi-Fi? — Yes, it **has**, but it's quite slow.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonangizda bepul **Wi-Fi bormi**? — Ha, **bor**, lekin ancha sekin.

sentences.text: **Does** Emma **have** any brothers or sisters? — Just one sister, in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **aka-ukasi yoki opa-singlisi bormi**? — Faqat bitta singlisi bor, Oksfordda.

sentences.text: I'm afraid the shop **hasn't got** that jacket in your size.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, do'konda bu kurtkaning sizga mos **o'lchami yo'q**.

sentences.text: How many children **have** they **got**? — Three, and the youngest is only two.
sentences.translation: Ularning nechta **farzandi bor**? — Uchta, eng kichigi atigi ikki yoshda.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't have** a passport yet, so she can't book the trip to London.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning hali **pasporti yo'q**, shuning uchun Londonga sayohatni bron qila olmaydi.

sentences.text: What kind of phone **have** you **got**? — The same as yours, actually.
sentences.translation: Sizda qanaqa **telefon bor**? — Aslida, siznikiga o'xshagan.

examples.title: Past and future: **had**, **didn't have**, **will have**
examples.description: have got faqat hozirgi zamonda. O'tmishda — had / didn't have / Did you have ...?, kelasida — will have; modal fe'l va to dan keyin ham faqat have.

sentences.text: When I was a child, we **had** a big garden with apricot trees.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda o'rik daraxtlari o'sgan katta **bog'imiz bor edi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **have** a mobile phone at school? — No, I **didn't**.
sentences.translation: Maktabda o'qiganingda **telefoning bormidi**? — Yo'q, **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Grandad **didn't have** a car, so he walked five kilometres to work.
sentences.translation: Bobomning **mashinasi yo'q edi**, shuning uchun ishga besh kilometr piyoda borardi.

sentences.text: Next year the school **will have** a new sports hall.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yil maktabda yangi sport **zali bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: You need to **have** a valid visa to work in the UK.
sentences.translation: Buyuk Britaniyada ishlash uchun amaldagi **vizangiz bo'lishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Kate **had** long hair at university, but now it's very short.
sentences.translation: Universitetda Keytning **sochi uzun edi**, hozir esa juda kalta.

sentences.text: I'd love to **have** a little house by the sea one day.
sentences.translation: Bir kuni dengiz bo'yida kichkina **uyim bo'lishini** juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: **Will** we **have** enough time to visit Bukhara as well?
sentences.translation: Buxoroga ham borishga **vaqtimiz yetadimi**?

sentences.text: The old flat **didn't have** central heating, so the winters were hard.
sentences.translation: Eski kvartirada markaziy **isitish yo'q edi**, shuning uchun qishlar og'ir o'tardi.

sentences.text: By the age of thirty, James **had** three restaurants in Manchester.
sentences.translation: O'ttiz yoshga kelib Jeymsning Manchesterda uchta **restorani bor edi**.

examples.title: Actions: **have breakfast**, **have a shower** — no **got**
examples.description: have + ot — harakat: have breakfast, have a shower, have a break, have a baby, have a look, have a chat. Bu yerda got ishlatilmaydi, o'zbekchada esa har biri boshqa fe'l bilan.

sentences.text: We usually **have breakfast** at seven, but on Sundays we sleep late.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat yettida **nonushta qilamiz**, lekin yakshanbalari kech turamiz.

sentences.text: After the long flight, Tom **had a shower** and went straight to bed.
sentences.translation: Uzoq parvozdan keyin Tom **dush qabul qildi** va darhol uxlashga yotdi.

sentences.text: Let's **have a break** — we've been working for three hours.
sentences.translation: Keling, **tanaffus qilamiz** — uch soatdan beri ishlayapmiz.

sentences.text: Madina and Jasur **had a baby** in March, a little girl called Zarina.
sentences.translation: Madina va Jasur mart oyida **farzand ko'rishdi** — Zarina ismli qizaloq.

sentences.text: Can I **have a look** at your notes? I missed the lecture.
sentences.translation: Konspektingga **bir qarab chiqsam** bo'ladimi? Ma'ruzani o'tkazib yubordim.

sentences.text: My parents **have a party** every year on their wedding anniversary.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam har yili to'y yilligida **ziyofat beradi**.

sentences.text: **Have a** safe trip, and **have a** great time in Edinburgh!
sentences.translation: Oq yo'l, Edinburgda **ajoyib vaqt o'tkazing**!

sentences.text: I **had a long chat** with my old teacher at the wedding yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha to'yda eski ustozim bilan **uzoq suhbatlashdim**.

sentences.text: Oliver and his brother **had an argument** about money, and now they aren't speaking.
sentences.translation: Oliver va akasi pul haqida **janjallashib qolishdi**, endi gaplashishmayapti.

sentences.text: Before the interview, Nilufar **had a cup of tea** to calm her nerves.
sentences.translation: Suhbatdan oldin Nilufar asablarini tinchlantirish uchun bir piyola **choy ichdi**.

examples.title: **I'm having** lunch / **Did** you **have** a good time?
examples.description: Harakat ma'nosidagi have Continuous da kela oladi (I'm having lunch) va savol-inkorda do / does / did bilan ishlatiladi. Egalik ma'nosidagi have Continuous da kelmaydi.

sentences.text: Can I call you back? **I'm having** dinner with my family.
sentences.translation: Keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilsam bo'ladimi? Oilam bilan **kechki ovqat qilyapman**.

sentences.text: Shh! The baby **is having** a nap, so please don't ring the bell.
sentences.translation: Jim! Chaqaloq **mizg'ib olyapti**, iltimos, qo'ng'iroqni chalmang.

sentences.text: **Did** you **have** a good time at the concert last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha konsertda **maza qildingizmi**?

sentences.text: What time **do** you usually **have** lunch at your office?
sentences.translation: Ofisingizda odatda soat nechada **tushlik qilasiz**?

sentences.text: We**'re having** a party on Saturday — would you like to come?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni **ziyofat qilyapmiz** — kelishni xohlaysizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah **didn't have** breakfast this morning because she overslept.
sentences.translation: Sara bugun ertalab **nonushta qilmadi**, chunki uxlab qolgan edi.

sentences.text: **Are** you **having** problems with your new laptop? — Yes, it keeps freezing.
sentences.translation: Yangi noutbukingiz bilan **muammo bo'lyaptimi**? — Ha, tez-tez qotib qolyapti.

sentences.text: **Does** your son **have** swimming lessons on Tuesdays or Thursdays?
sentences.translation: O'g'lingiz suzish **darsiga** seshanba kunlari **boradimi** yoki payshanba?

sentences.text: Bekzod **was having** a shower when the earthquake started.
sentences.translation: Zilzila boshlanganida Bekzod **dush qabul qilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Everyone **is having** a great time, but the music is a bit too loud.
sentences.translation: Hamma **maza qilyapti**, lekin musiqa biroz baland.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a weekend in Samarkand
examples.description: Ikki do'st dam olish kunlarini rejalashtiradi: egalik (have got, have, had) va harakat (have dinner, have a good time) bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — **Have** you **got** any plans for the weekend, Aziz?
sentences.translation: — Aziz, dam olish kunlariga **rejalaring bormi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. Why? **Have** you **got** an idea?
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Nega? Biror **fikring bormi**?

sentences.text: — Yes! My cousin**'s got** a guest house in Samarkand, and it's empty this week.
sentences.translation: — Ha! Amakivachchamning Samarqandda **mehmon uyi bor**, bu hafta bo'sh turibdi.

sentences.text: — Sounds great, but I **haven't got** much money at the moment.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r eshitiladi, lekin hozir **pulim unchalik ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, he won't charge us. We can **have** dinner at the bazaar, too.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, u bizdan pul olmaydi. Bozorda **kechki ovqat qilsak** ham bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Perfect. **Do** you **have** a car, or shall we take the train?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. **Mashinang bormi** yoki poyezdda boramizmi?

sentences.text: — I **had** a car last year, but I sold it. Let's take the fast train.
sentences.translation: — O'tgan yili **mashinam bor edi**, lekin sotib yubordim. Tezyurar poyezdga chiqamiz.

sentences.text: — Fine. I**'ve got** a meeting on Friday morning, so we can leave at two.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Juma kuni ertalab **uchrashuvim bor**, shuning uchun soat ikkida jo'nashimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: — Great! I'll book the tickets now — **have** you **got** your passport number?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Hozir chiptalarni bron qilaman — pasport **raqaming bormi**?

sentences.text: — Here it is. I can't wait — we're going to **have** a wonderful time!
sentences.translation: — Mana. Sabrim chidamayapti — **zo'r dam olamiz**!

examples.title: Mixed: possession or action?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: egalik (have / have got), harakat (have a word, having a meeting), o'tmish va kelasi (had, will have) — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The manager can't see you now because she**'s having** a meeting with the investors.
sentences.translation: Menejer hozir sizni qabul qila olmaydi, chunki investorlar bilan **majlis o'tkazyapti**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **got** a minute? I need to **have a word** with you about the project.
sentences.translation: Bir **daqiqangiz bormi**? Loyiha haqida siz bilan **gaplashib olishim kerak**.

sentences.text: Our village **didn't have** electricity until the 1960s, my grandmother says.
sentences.translation: Buvimning aytishicha, qishlog'imizda 1960-yillargacha **elektr yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur**'s got** a strong accent, but his English is excellent.
sentences.translation: Jasurning **kuchli aksenti bor**, lekin ingliz tili a'lo darajada.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is having** difficulty finding a flat near her new job.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yangi ishi yaqinidan kvartira topishda **qiynalyapti**.

sentences.text: **Has** the new hospital **got** enough doctors, or is it still recruiting?
sentences.translation: Yangi shifoxonada **shifokorlar yetarlimi** yoki hali ham xodim yollayaptimi?

sentences.text: Tom **had** a heart attack last year, so now he **has** a check-up every three months.
sentences.translation: Tom o'tgan yili **infarkt bo'ldi**, shuning uchun endi har uch oyda **tekshiruvdan o'tadi**.

sentences.text: In the future, every home **will have** solar panels on the roof, experts say.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislarning aytishicha, kelajakda har bir uyning tomida quyosh **panellari bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We **don't have** dinner until nine in summer because it's too hot to eat earlier.
sentences.translation: Yozda soat to'qqizgacha **kechki ovqat qilmaymiz**, chunki ertaroq ovqatlanishga havo juda issiq.

sentences.text: Emma **hasn't got** a garden, but she **has** lots of plants on her balcony.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **bog'i yo'q**, lekin balkonida ko'p o'simlik **bor**.
